description: Defines a reference counting base class and a smart pointer template for managing reference-counted objects in the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QuicheReferenceCounted
classes.description: Base class for explicitly reference-counted objects in QUIC.

classes.name: QuicheReferenceCountedPointer
classes.description: Template class for a reference-counted smart pointer managing objects of type T.

methods.name: QuicheReferenceCountedPointer(T* p)
methods.description: Constructs from a raw pointer, assuming reference count of 1.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereference operator for the referenced object.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Member access operator for the referenced object.

methods.name: operator bool
methods.description: Boolean conversion to check if pointer is non-null.

methods.name: operator=(T* p)
methods.description: Assigns a raw pointer, assuming reference count of 1.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns the raw pointer without changing reference count.
